title: Lila Gizzie
text: I am a sophomore at Georgetown Univeristy double majoring in Computer Science and German. My interests beyond these disciplines include cultural/linguistic anthropology, international cybersecurity, and space technology.

title: Minority Languages and Globalization Project Updates
text:
Through this project, I aim to discuss how globalization continues to negatively impact minority language survival. Furthermore, my combination of static and dynamic graphics will engage with how AI may or may not prove a viable solution to language revitalization in 2026 and beyond.
This website holds my most recent visualizations, and I will eventually deploy the entire narrative onto an independent website domain. Until then, enjoy my work here!
Sources: Forkel (2024)
